crossRefs.note: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!
Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.
let them praise Yahweh’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
Therefore David blessed Yahweh before all the assembly; and David said, “You are blessed, Yahweh, the God of Israel our…
Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”
Pray like this: ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…

translations.web: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
translations.bsb: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
translations.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
translations.asv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, And thy glory above all the earth.
